status: owner-reviewed; exact three removals applied in revision 31
scope: Review all 2,339 approved spellings: 2,306 integrated in revision 30 and 33 owner-approved additions in batches 13–15 awaiting integration. Pending/rejected spellings are excluded from this approved-pool audit.
criteria: Find analogues of removed ordinal numerals, approximate-colour forms and productive prefixed adjectives. Screened all approved words, their recorded parts of speech and meanings; manually reviewed adjective groups. Did not classify all words beginning with უ or მო as derivatives.

falsePositiveControls.reason: Approved meaning second is a time unit, not an ordinal.
Firstborn child is an independent noun, not an ordinal numeral.
First New Year visitor is a role noun, not an ordinal.
Approved but awaiting integration: this is a noun, not a negative adjective merely because the spelling starts with უ.
Do not classify lexical nouns/basic adjectives as removed-style forms solely from initial letters.

limitations: The original audit removed nothing. The subsequent owner decision removes exactly მოგრძო, უკვალო and უკუდო in revision 31; the other 36 retain prior approvals.
Similarity groups are editorial judgments, not claims that these are incorrect Georgian words or case-inflected forms. Many are ordinary independent adjectives.
The similarity groups are retained as audit history; the exact subsequent three-word owner choice is recorded in ownerReview.
No broad adjective ban is inferred. Only the three explicit approvals are withdrawn; no historical pack is modified.
Recorded source provenance supports the approved senses; new web dictionary rechecks focus on the three closest candidates. No native-speaker review is claimed.
Usage counts describe the revision-30 audit snapshot. Subsequent revision-31 repairs, metrics and validation are recorded separately in VOCABULARY_FORM_REMOVALS_2026_10_26.json.
